description: 3-stage open redirect via pathname routing: (1) add subdomain-aware redirect with origin whitelist validation on serviceURL, (2) allow path preservation for deep linking (append path to validated origin), (3) 'simplify origin extraction — use pathname for flexible routing' — replaces new URL(serviceURL).origin validation with .pathname pass-through, removing the whitelist check entirely. Attacker sends serviceURL=https://evil.com/steal and the server redirects there with a valid ssoToken.
